notes.description:
When a ticket is:
Created By External Contact
And the following conditions are met:
Created From Datto RMM Alert equal to "False"
Queue not equal to  "SaaS Alerts"
UDF: EmailSuppress not equal to  "True"
Event occurs Inside Business Hours of Headquarters
Then execute the following actions:
Assign To Queue "Triage"
Set Status To "New"
Set Priority To "Medium"
Send notification e-mail (New Ticket Created (HTML) wo portal) to Ticket Contact (lisa@webmyers.com)
Initiated by Lisa Wilson
notes.title: Workflow Rule "Notify Customer of New Ticket - created by external contact" fired.
